title: Entering Trades — The LTE Methodology

edits.reason: Lesson teaches two headline concepts that the Sr-Flip chart never draws. Invalidation: 'the predefined level where your trade thesis is WRONG; this IS your stop loss placement; never move it' — the Sr-flip long (entry ~105/107) is invalidated on a close back below the flipped level; yAxis 103 sits inside the 88-123 band, just under the flip line @105 and the retest low. First Barrier: 'the earliest minor S/R where price could stall or begin to fail — not the stop loss, but the first warning sign' — 111 is the prior swing high (leg 2 to:111) the post-entry rally must reclaim, the earliest stall point above the entry; inside band, above the flip. Both pink per palette (a stop against a long / minor resistance).
